description:
[measured + lexicon] Crypto Twitter pulse for one coin: the latest English posts on X with
    replies, retweets, spam and tiny accounts dropped; a bullish/bearish lean from -100 to +100
    weighted by engagement and reach (a crypto word lexicon: rough, sarcasm fools it); posts per
    hour; the top posts with author and link; and next to them the coin's funding rate, open
    interest change and long/short positioning, with one sentence on whether talk and
    positioning agree. Cached 10 minutes. Priced: $0.02 per call (x402), 4 prepaid credits, or a
    key's quota.
